product.title: Grand Canyon Helicopter 45-Minute Flight with Optional Hummer Tour

description.text: Choose a standalone 45-minute helicopter flight or bundle it with a ground Hummer tour of the South Rim. The aerial segment covers both rims and the Colorado River while the optional Hummer portion adds rim-edge stops unreachable by standard buses.

highlights: 45-minute helicopter flight over the Grand Canyon
Optional add-on Hummer ground tour of the South Rim
Views of North Rim, South Rim, and Colorado River
Flexible booking for flight-only or combo packages

start.description: Check in at the Papillon helicopter terminal in Tusayan, AZ 86023. Allow 30 minutes for check-in before flight time.

end.description: Return to the Tusayan terminal after landing; Hummer guests transfer to the ground tour staging area.

product.itinerarySummary: Choose a standalone 45-minute helicopter flight or bundle it with a ground Hummer tour of the South Rim.

itineraryItems.description: Initial climb over Kaibab National Forest before reaching the rim.

itineraryItems.description: Aerial views toward the less-visited North Rim plateau.

itineraryItems.description: Follow the Colorado River corridor visible from the helicopter cabin.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon South Rim
itineraryItems.description: Optional Hummer tour stops at South Rim viewpoints after the flight.
